O1.title: Build the WinUI 3 desktop application
O1.statement: Design and develop a packaged Windows 11 x64 WinUI 3 application with a guided non-specialist workflow.

O2.title: Implement model import, download and inspection
O2.statement: Select local or approved downloaded Granite models, validate them and show trustworthy inspection states.

O3.title: Analyse Intel hardware and estimate memory
O3.statement: Read Intel hardware/system data and provide a transparent calibrated memory-fit estimate.

O4.title: Generate and explain supported configurations
O4.statement: Create only complete verified model/runtime/cache/device combinations and goal-based modes.

O5.title: Integrate local command-line inference backends
O5.statement: Safely launch/control local runtimes through adapters without requiring terminal commands.

O6.title: Provide a local chat experience
O6.statement: Support responsive streaming, cancellation and at least two turns with actual runtime/device reporting.

O7.title: Implement model optimisation and export
O7.statement: Create and validate at least one new GGUF weight-quantised artefact with provenance.

O8.title: Verify llama.cpp, OpenVINO and TurboQuant on Intel
O8.statement: Establish exact supported routes, backend/device evidence, fallbacks and limitations.

O9.title: Implement a TurboVec-assisted knowledge workflow
O9.statement: Import a knowledge file, create embeddings, compress/optimise vectors, retrieve evidence and use it in chat.

O10.title: Evaluate memory, quality and performance trade-offs
O10.statement: Assess 4/8/16 GB budgets and compare memory, context, speed, quality and stability.

O11.title: Test, package and document the system
O11.statement: Provide traceable verification, evidence, reproducibility, manuals and release controls.

RQ1.title: Intel hardware and runtime compatibility
RQ1.statement: Which selected IBM Granite models and routes—upstream llama.cpp, TurboQuant-enabled llama.cpp forks, official OpenVINO GenAI and OpenVINO GenAI with TurboQuant—run reliably on the tested Windows Intel CPU/integrated GPU, and what limitations or fallbacks apply?

RQ2.title: TurboQuant memory, quality and performance trade-off
RQ2.statement: Compared with matched standard KV-cache baselines, how much do verified TurboQuant implementations reduce KV-cache and total memory use, and what effects do they have on quality, context, speed and stability?

RQ3.title: Feasibility within lower-memory systems
RQ3.statement: Which complete Granite configurations are practical within 4 GB, 8 GB and 16 GB total system-memory budgets, and how do model size, weights, cache, context, runtime and device affect outcomes?

RQ4.title: End-to-end application usefulness and reliability
RQ4.statement: How reliably and clearly can the WinUI application let non-specialists import/download, inspect, assess, configure and run a local Granite model without command-line knowledge?

RQ-TV.title: TurboVec knowledge-retrieval value
RQ-TV.statement: Can a pinned TurboVec implementation run on the target Windows Intel system and provide useful vector compression and retrieval for the selected Granite knowledge-file workflow compared with an uncompressed baseline?

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must open on the target Windows 11 x64 Intel computer.
requirements_baseline.rationale: A usable prototype must launch on the target platform.

requirements_baseline.notes: ModelImportPage and release packaging still need completion.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must let the user select a supported local model.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Model import is the first user task.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: A user selects a valid GGUF file with the Windows picker; cancel returns safely; path is retained for inspection.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Picker integration test and UI test
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Model-import page is in progress.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must validate a selected input before using it.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Untrusted or corrupt files must not reach a runtime.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Missing, empty, wrong-type, truncated and corrupt fixtures are rejected with a classified reason; valid fixture proceeds.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must show the correct inspection result state.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users need a consistent decision before continuing.
requirements_baseline.source: MoSCoW v1.1 F-M04; acceptance rule p.6
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Fixtures produce Ready, Ready with warnings, Conversion required, Unsupported, and Invalid or incomplete.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: State-decision table test and UI state test

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must display the model details needed for compatibility and memory checks.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Later decisions depend on trustworthy metadata.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: For a verified Granite GGUF, the app displays format, architecture/name where available, file size, weight type, context information, tokenizer/chat-template information or explicit missing-data warnings.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Real-model inspection test and fixture tests

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must show plain-English reasons for warnings or failures.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Non-specialist users must understand what happened.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Every tested failure code maps to a non-technical explanation and a valid recovery action; no raw exception is the only user message.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Failure-message tests and task-based usability test

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must read the hardware information needed for fit analysis.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Memory and backend recommendations require current hardware data.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: The app records CPU details, installed and available RAM, available GPU/device information, disk space and runtime availability with clear units; values are cross-checked against trusted Windows tools.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must estimate peak memory for a supported configuration.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users need a transparent fit prediction before loading a model.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: The estimate shows weights, KV cache, runtime/app overhead, OS allowance and safety reserve; matched measured error is recorded.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must show whether a configuration is likely to fit, needs optimisation, or has no verified safe option.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The raw estimate must become an understandable decision.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Boundary tests change the result at documented thresholds and show the limiting reason and uncertainty.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must generate only complete configurations valid for the current model, runtime and device.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Individually valid settings can still form an invalid combination.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: All approved combinations are generated; all known invalid model/weight/cache/runtime/backend/device combinations are rejected.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must provide Automatic, Quality, Balanced and Efficiency modes when valid alternatives exist.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users need goal-based choices rather than low-level flags.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Each visible mode resolves to a complete valid configuration with a documented ranking rationale; unavailable modes are hidden or disabled; slider label updates correctly.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Mode algorithm tests and UI interaction tests
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: The model-preferences slider UI exists but final algorithm is not implemented.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must show the chosen complete configuration before starting an operation.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users must understand what will run and whether it is experimental.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Before launch the UI shows model, runtime, backend, actual/requested device target, weight format, KV cache, context, estimated memory, status and selection reason.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must run local chat with at least one supported Granite GGUF model.
requirements_baseline.rationale: A complete inference result proves the selected configuration is usable.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: One real Granite GGUF completes import, inspection, fit, selection, loading and valid local generation through WinUI without manual terminal commands.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Upstream Granite runtime feasibility is complete outside the app.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must keep the original model file unchanged.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Inspection and optimisation must not damage the user's source asset.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: SHA-256 before and after inspection/processing is identical; generated artefacts use a different path.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must give the user a clear next step after a failure.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Failure handling must support recovery, not only reporting.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Each formal failure case offers a safe action such as Retry, Choose another model/configuration, Open details, or Return to standard route.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must download at least one approved recommended Granite model from a fixed trusted source.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The agreed product aim includes controlled model download for non-specialists.
requirements_baseline.source: Agreed Project Definition §5.2.3; promoted from C-01
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: A listed model shows source/licence/size/location, downloads with progress, and enters inspection after completion.
requirements_baseline.notes: New scope item; timetable must be re-baselined.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must prevent partial, corrupt or unverified downloads from being used as valid models.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Large external assets require integrity and failure controls.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Disk space is checked; cancellation/failure leaves no valid-state artefact; final size and SHA-256 match the approved manifest.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The WinUI application must launch and control supported local command-line runtimes without requiring the user to enter terminal commands.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The app's main contribution is to hide specialist CLI operation behind a safe adapter.
requirements_baseline.source: Agreed Objective O5; promoted from F-S13
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Structured arguments, redirected stdout/stderr, hidden console, startup/error result, timeout and process-tree cleanup all pass tests.

requirements_baseline.requirement: Chat and long-running operations must stream progress/output and support safe cancellation.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users need responsiveness and control during model operations.
requirements_baseline.source: Agreed Project Definition §5.2.9–5.2.12; promoted from F-S05/F-S06
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Output appears during generation; cancellation during loading/generation/download/processing returns a controlled state and leaves no child process or partial valid artefact.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Streaming, responsiveness, cancellation and cleanup tests

requirements_baseline.requirement: The local chat must support at least two user turns in the same session.
requirements_baseline.rationale: A real chat workflow needs maintained conversation context.
requirements_baseline.source: Agreed Project Definition §5.2.12; promoted from F-S07
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Two sequential prompts complete; second prompt uses the intended session context; reset starts a new session.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must run at least one verified TurboQuant-enabled Granite configuration end to end.
requirements_baseline.rationale: TurboQuant is a central contribution and must be more than an external benchmark.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: A pinned supported model/runtime/cache/device combination is selected in WinUI, loads, generates through normal chat, proves TQ activation, records actual state, and supports cancellation.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: App-integrated TurboQuant E2E and activation audit
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: AtomicBot feasibility: 15 formal passes; OpenVINO TQ U4 also validated outside app.

requirements_baseline.requirement: A dependable upstream llama.cpp configuration must remain available when the TurboQuant route is unavailable or fails.
requirements_baseline.rationale: An experimental backend must not make the core product unusable.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: A forced TQ unavailability/failure returns the user to a verified upstream configuration without claiming TQ was active.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must create one new validated GGUF model artefact through a supported weight-quantisation workflow.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The project includes a real model-file optimisation/export capability separate from KV-cache optimisation.
requirements_baseline.source: Agreed Objective O7; promoted from F-S09
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: A suitable source model is processed into a new GGUF, original hash is unchanged, output loads/inspects and can be selected for chat.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Processing integration, hash, reinspection and generation tests

requirements_baseline.requirement: Each generated model artefact must have a processing manifest containing source/output hashes, tool/version, settings and result.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Optimised artefacts need provenance and reproducibility.
requirements_baseline.source: Agreed Objective O7; promoted from F-S10
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Manifest is saved for success and classified failure and validates against the agreed schema.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Manifest schema/contract test and evidence audit

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must import and preserve at least one supported text-based knowledge file for the bounded retrieval workflow.
requirements_baseline.rationale: TurboVec requires a document-to-vector workflow distinct from model import.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: A supported local file is validated, text is extracted/chunked, and the original file hash remains unchanged.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Fixture, extraction, chunking and hash tests
requirements_baseline.notes: Exact supported file type and size limit must be frozen.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must create an uncompressed embedding baseline and use the selected TurboVec implementation to compress or optimise the vectors.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The agreed TurboVec contribution concerns vector storage, not original document compression.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Pinned embedding/TurboVec versions produce both baseline and compressed vector artefacts with recorded dimensions, sizes, timings and hashes.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must retrieve relevant sections from the local index and provide them to the Granite chat workflow.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The TurboVec result must be usable by the end application.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: For a fixed question set, retrieved chunks are shown/recorded and passed into Granite; answer and retrieval evidence are retained.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The user must be able to copy generated chat output.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users need to reuse useful local output.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Copy action places the exact selected/full generated response on the Windows clipboard and handles empty output safely.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must compare at least one verified TurboQuant run with a matched standard KV-cache baseline.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The core research contribution is a controlled memory/quality/performance trade-off.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Same model, weights, prompt/template, context, settings, hardware and measurement method; TQ activation proved; differences reported.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: AtomicBot and OpenVINO TQ comparisons exist outside the final app.
requirements_baseline.notes: Final app-integrated matched comparison still required.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must identify, pin and document the exact TurboVec implementation and its role in the release.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The implementation name alone is insufficient for safe integration.
requirements_baseline.source: MoSCoW v1.1 R-M02 revised by agreed scope
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Repository, commit/version, licence, platform, input/output, vector representation and retrieval contract are recorded before integration.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Source inspection, licence review and technical spike
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: User has selected TurboVec conceptually; exact implementation remains unverified.
requirements_baseline.notes: This is a critical assumption and gate.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must complete and preserve an official OpenVINO GenAI Granite baseline or a reproducible blocker.
requirements_baseline.rationale: OpenVINO is the second Intel route and needs evidence distinct from community/custom routes.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Exact official-source model/revision, conversion/runtime versions, requested/actual device and outcome are recorded; pass or blocker is reproducible.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Community preconverted CPU/GPU baseline and OpenVINO TQ U4/U3 complete; official-source FP16 runtime and INT8 structural conversion retest progressed.
requirements_baseline.notes: Do not merge community-model evidence with official-source retest.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must measure memory use for every final test configuration.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Memory is central to the project aim.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Each final row records available RAM before, peak process-tree working set/private where used, relevant GPU shared memory and measurement definition.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Existing upstream, AtomicBot, animehacker and OpenVINO campaigns contain memory evidence with different definitions.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must evaluate runtime performance for every final test configuration.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Memory savings alone do not prove usefulness.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Cold/warm load, TTFT, prompt speed, generation speed and total response duration are reported where available using fixed definitions and repetitions.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Existing completed runtime campaigns provide substantial evidence.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must compare output quality with a fixed prompt set and scoring guide.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Compression must be evaluated against model behaviour.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Prompt/rubric versions are frozen before final comparison; raw answers, instruction/format/fact scores and limitations are retained.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: OpenVINO TQ U4 scored 10/10 and U3 6/10 under the controlled test; AtomicBot raw-output recovery remains relevant.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must identify the largest stable tested context for selected final configurations.
requirements_baseline.rationale: KV-cache optimisation matters most as context grows.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: A versioned step test records maximum attempted and maximum stable context, success/retrieval result, memory and failure reason; it is not called the model maximum.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: OpenVINO community route tested approximately 4K with task-dependent retrieval reliability.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must preserve a complete record of every final experiment.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Results must be auditable and reproducible.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Each formal experiment has an ID, hardware/model/runtime/config hashes, requested/actual state, command, raw stdout/stderr, measurements, outputs and failure status.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Completed workbooks exist, but some raw evidence remains on external local paths and needs recovery.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must record failed attempts and known limitations.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Negative results prevent biased conclusions and support troubleshooting.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Every formal failure has ID, stage, code, evidence, likely cause, next action and resolution status; limitations appear in final documentation.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Existing workbooks contain useful failure logs.

requirements_baseline.requirement: Another developer must be able to reproduce the clean build and core result from written instructions.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Academic engineering evidence must be reproducible.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Independent clean-checkout reproduction completes the documented x64 build, tests and main upstream route; deviations are recorded.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must determine which selected Granite/runtime/backend combinations run reliably on the tested Intel CPU and integrated GPU.
requirements_baseline.rationale: RQ1 requires exact compatibility evidence, not a universal Intel claim.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Matrix includes upstream llama.cpp, selected TQ forks, official OpenVINO and OpenVINO TQ with model, commit/version, build, requested/actual device, success/failure and role.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Upstream, AtomicBot, animehacker and community OpenVINO evidence already cover many tested cases.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must assess selected complete configurations against 4 GB, 8 GB and 16 GB total system-memory budgets.
requirements_baseline.rationale: RQ3 explicitly concerns lower-memory feasibility.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Each result is labelled physical, controlled-limit, calculated or predicted and includes OS/app/model/KV/runtime/shared-memory allowance and uncertainty.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must compare TurboVec-compressed or optimised vectors with an uncompressed-vector baseline.
requirements_baseline.rationale: A vector-compression feature needs a matched effectiveness test.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Same documents, chunking, embeddings and queries; compare storage, memory, index/query time, relevance, answer usefulness, failures and stability.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must quantify memory-estimator error and false-safe/false-unsafe recommendations.
requirements_baseline.rationale: An estimator must be calibrated rather than merely demonstrated.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Matched rows report predicted, measured, absolute error, percentage error, fit decision, false-safe/false-unsafe and confidence.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The core workflow must work locally after required models and tools are installed.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Local inference is the product's defining operational property.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: With network disconnected, model inspection, configuration selection and upstream local chat complete using installed assets.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must not upload models, prompts, knowledge files or answers to a cloud AI service in the core workflow.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Target sectors require careful data handling.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Network inspection shows no cloud AI upload during core model/document/chat workflow; any initial approved download is separately documented.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application window must remain responsive during long tasks.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Blocking the UI makes download, loading, quantisation and generation unusable.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: UI input/paint remains responsive during each long task; no synchronous runtime call blocks the UI thread.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must show the current state of a long task.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users need progress and confidence that work is continuing.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Each long operation reports at least Starting, Running/Loading/Generating/Processing, Completed, Cancelled or Failed; progress is determinate where available.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must handle model/document paths and process arguments safely.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Imported paths and CLI arguments are untrusted boundaries.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Tests cover spaces, Unicode, quotes and supported special characters; no shell string concatenation/injection path is used.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The application must clean temporary files and stopped child processes.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Cancellation and failures must not leave unsafe resource leaks.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Success, cancellation, timeout and crash tests leave no unintended child process and no partial artefact marked complete.

requirements_baseline.requirement: Each final run must record requested and actual backend, device and optimisation state.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Silent fallback would invalidate compatibility and performance claims.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Manifest separates requested from actual runtime/backend/device/cache and cites the evidence used to determine actual state.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Existing feasibility workbooks already apply this rule in many routes.

requirements_baseline.requirement: A clean copy of the repository must build and run its automated tests.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The prototype must not depend on an unrecorded local machine state.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Documented x64 restore/build/test commands pass from a clean checkout in the pinned environment.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Current solution has built locally; full test/CI baseline still needs completion.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The repository must not contain secrets, personal test data or large proprietary model files.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The public/private repo must remain safe and legally manageable.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Release scan finds no credentials, real patient/pupil data, unapproved model weights or prohibited third-party files.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Repository structure and ignore rules exist but final scan is pending.

requirements_baseline.requirement: Experimental options must be clearly labelled in the interface.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Users must not confuse limited-evidence routes with dependable ones.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Every Experimental registry entry displays a persistent label and limitations before selection and launch.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: Registry/UI inspection test and UX task

requirements_baseline.requirement: An experimental option must not be reported as active unless activation is proved.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Accepted flags and successful output are insufficient proof.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: When proof is absent the run is labelled Unverified/Fallback rather than active; supported routes have direct activation evidence.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: AtomicBot/OpenVINO workbooks contain repository-specific activation evidence and cautions.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The main local inference route must not require a local web server or open network port.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Direct child-process communication reduces attack surface and deployment complexity.
planned_components: Redirected standard streams or other non-network IPC
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Main upstream route completes with no listening port created by the application/runtime; evidence is recorded.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The main workflow must support keyboard operation and Windows text scaling.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The intended users require a basic accessible desktop experience.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Core tasks complete keyboard-only; focus is visible; content remains usable at 200% Windows text scaling with no critical clipping.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must produce a basic distributable Windows x64 release build with documented dependencies.
requirements_baseline.rationale: A working project needs a repeatable handover artefact, even if full MSIX is deferred.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Release artefact launches on the target machine; checksum, commit/tag, runtime dependencies and install/run steps are recorded.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project problem, aim, research questions, objectives, first-release scope, exclusions and satisfactory outcome must be version-controlled.
requirements_baseline.rationale: All requirements and evaluation must derive from a stable project definition.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Dated document contains all agreed sections, source links and status; linked from repository README.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: The content has been drafted in conversation; repository freeze is pending.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must maintain one versioned MoSCoW requirements baseline with stable IDs and measurable acceptance criteria.
requirements_baseline.rationale: A single controlled catalogue prevents contradictory requirements.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Every active Must has a stable ID, source, rationale, acceptance and verification; changes are dated and approved.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: MoSCoW v1.1 exists; agreed scope changes require v1.2.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must maintain bidirectional traceability from requirements to objectives/RQs, work packages, implementation, tests and evidence.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Nothing important should be forgotten or counted complete without proof.
requirements_baseline.source: MoSCoW §9; engineering audit; corrected timetable PD-04
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: No active Must row lacks source, rationale, acceptance, WP, component, verification, evidence path, owner and status; release audit confirms reverse links.
requirements_baseline.verification_method: RTM completeness formula and manual audit

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must record proportionate architecture views, key ADRs, stable contracts, states and diagnostic codes.
requirements_baseline.rationale: UI and backend work need clear boundaries and justified decisions.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Context/component/process/deployment views and ADRs for WinUI, adapters/no port, upstream/TQ/OpenVINO/TurboVec/evidence agree with code and requirements.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Narrative architecture exists; formal views/ADRs/contracts remain incomplete.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project must maintain a consolidated risk, assumption, constraint and licence register.
requirements_baseline.rationale: High-risk experimental dependencies and sector claims require active control.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Each high risk has probability, impact, owner, trigger, validation, mitigation, contingency and status; assumptions are confirmed/rejected with evidence; licences are reviewed.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Constraints and assumptions have been drafted; live registers are pending.

requirements_baseline.requirement: Requirement and scope changes must be linked to dated decisions, GitHub issues, pull requests/commits and affected tests.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The project must not silently rewrite history.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Every approved change records reason, date, affected IDs/WPs/tests/report sections and superseded/replacement links.

requirements_baseline.requirement: Irreplaceable raw evidence from completed feasibility campaigns must be recovered, hashed, indexed and backed up.
requirements_baseline.rationale: Workbook summaries alone may not support final claims.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Upstream, AtomicBot, animehacker and OpenVINO campaigns each have model/runtime/hash manifest, raw-output location, checksum and independent backup or explicit gap.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Completed workbooks exist; several original paths refer to local experiment folders.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The release must include a README, user manual, developer/build guide, known limitations and final feature-status table.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The system must be understandable and handover-ready.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Documents cover install/run/use/build/test/evidence/limitations; feature statuses match the RTM.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The final release must be tied to a Git tag, checksums, evidence pack, independent backup and evidence-based answers to every RQ.
requirements_baseline.rationale: The final project must have a controlled baseline and defensible conclusions.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Tag/commit/checksums/backups exist; all Must rows have final status/evidence; report answers each RQ and states limitations/negative results.

requirements_baseline.rationale: Drag-and-drop improves convenience after the picker route is stable.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Supported file drop follows the same validation path; invalid/multiple drops are handled.

requirements_baseline.rationale: The second runtime route needs correct multi-file input recognition.
requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Valid XML/BIN/tokenizer/config folder is recognised and incomplete folder receives a classified result.

requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Only supported range/steps are allowed and estimator/configuration update immediately.

requirements_baseline.requirement: The project should provide one verified source-to-OpenVINO model-preparation route.

requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Pinned IBM source revision converts in a clean recorded environment and the output passes structure/runtime checks, or a reproducible blocker is preserved.
requirements_baseline.existing_evidence: Official-source FP16 conversion/runtime and INT8 structural validation have progressed in the retest campaign.

requirements_baseline.acceptance_criteria: Fresh install/uninstall works on the target Windows machine and dependencies/limitations are documented.
